scope.purpose: validate the fixed production runtime-identity producer and the evidence of the fix
scope.runtime: local producer capture - no Modal invocation, no deployment, no GPU, no change to a deployed worker
scope.benchmark_run: not touched - the 16-target run on disk still fails the Iteration 16-18 validators and this iteration does not change that

checks.planned: the source of the production producer contains no call of modal.running_app, which is a module and not a callable in Modal SDK 1.5.5
the capture was made locally: no Modal invocation, no deployment, no GPU and no change to a deployed worker
the sentinel that stood in for modal.running_app while the producer ran was never touched
every identity fact of the envelope is a typed fact that names the worker side, and the envelope satisfies the unchanged Iteration 18 schema
'app_id' is an explicit NOT_AVAILABLE with the exact reason of the producer and holds no value
'app_page_url' is an explicit NOT_AVAILABLE with the exact reason of the producer and holds no value
'container_id' is an explicit NOT_AVAILABLE with the exact reason of the producer and holds no value
the application id and the app page URL are client-side facts with the provider's shape, and the worker envelope holds no client-side fact
the SHA-256 of the stage evidence artifact on disk equals the digest the capture record claims
the stage evidence artifact satisfies the unchanged Iteration 18 artifact contract and carries exactly the envelope of the captured response
the facts derived from the envelope keep the side the envelope declared
the capture names the commit it was made from, and that commit is the one the report is bound to

interpretation.planned: validate the source of the fixed production producer, the capture of the real producer, the unchanged Iteration 18 artifact and envelope contracts, the worker/client distinction of every fact and the binding of the report to the code SHA it was produced from
interpretation.attempted: the producer source, the sentinel on modal.running_app, the envelope of the capture, the client-side observation, the stage evidence artifact and its digest, and the source binding
interpretation.executed: the checks were executed against the artifacts stored on disk
interpretation.observed: the report states exactly what the capture record and the stage evidence artifact contain; a fact the worker cannot observe is reported as NOT_AVAILABLE with its reason and is never filled in
interpretation.reported: PASSED means every check of the fixed production producer passed; FAILED means at least one did not. The capture is a LOCAL capture of the producer: no Modal invocation was made, no worker was deployed and no live validation is claimed. The deployed workers still need a new deployment to carry the fix, and that is outside this iteration
